CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
April 27, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR PUBLIC SCHOOLS MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim April 2021 as Public Schools Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Norwalk-La Mirada Unified School District Board Vice President Norma Amezcua.
5.1 Proclamation for Public Schools Month
5.2
PROCLAMATION FOR ARBOR DAY – It is recommended the City Council proclaim April 30, 2021 as Arbor Day in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Public Works Director Mark Stowell.
5.2 Proclamation for Arbor Day
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION – It is recommended the City Council appoint Raymond Fernandez to the Community Services Commission for a term ending in June 2024.
7.1 Appointment to the Community Services Commission
7.2
REAPPOINTMENTS TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council reappoint Pete Dames, Glenn Gonzalez, John Grotz, Russell Hall, David Harbaugh, Michelle Lynch, Hal Malkin, Martin Nava and Lesley Watkins to the La Mirada Community Foundation for terms ending in May 2023.
7.2 Reappointment to the La Mirada Community Foundation
7.3
CITY COUNCIL APPOINTMENTS TO VARIOUS AGENCIES - It is recommended the Mayor make the necessary appointments of delegates and alternates to the various organizations on which members of the City Council participate.

APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of April 13, 2021 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of April 13, 2021.
8.1 Minutes of the April 13, 2021 SS
8.1 Minutes of the April 13, 2021 CC
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated April 27, 2021 in the total amount of $1,785,345.18.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-04, NEFF HOUSE, GEORGE HOUSE AND CARRIAGE BARN EXTERIOR SURFACE REPAIR AND PAINT - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-04, Neff House, George House and Carriage Barn Exterior Surface Repair and Paint; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
8.3 CIP No. 2021-04

RESOLUTION NO. 21-14 AFFIRMING A VOTE OF NO CONFIDENCE FOR LOS ANGELES COUNTY DISTRICT ATTORNEY GEORGE GASCON'S SPECIAL DIRECTIVES - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-14 affirming a vote of no confidence for Los Angeles County District Attorney George Gascon's Special Directives.
